Subject: Vendor setup + MSA edits for Ariba onboarding

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Quick intro — I manage supplier onboarding at Sunside Health. We're ready to activate Redwood in our Ariba instance but hit two gating items:

1) Ariba requires a vendor code mapping to a PO prefix (our finance sys needs PO numbers to start with vendor codes for automated routing). Can Redwood include a vendor_code prefix on the order form or provide guidance on the PO metadata mapping?

2) Our legal team requests two small edits to the MSA: a) explicit EU data residency option (we'll choose US/Global initially but want the option in the MSA) and b) a defined PO acknowledgment window of 5 business days in the Order Form.

I've attached our Ariba vendor activation form plus a redline from our procurement advisor to illustrate the requested PO prefix field. Can we get a short plan + timeline so we can keep our activation window next week?

Attachments: [VendorPortal_RequestForm.xlsx (xlsx)], [Sunside_Orderform_template.pdf (pdf)], [Sunside_MSA_redline_v1.docx (docx)]

Thanks,

Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. High-level plan below; legal (Markus) and ops (Laura) are looped in to confirm feasibility and timeline.

Quick answers and proposed next steps:
- Vendor code / PO prefix: We can add an optional "vendor_code" metadata field on the Order Form that gets sent with each PO. Laura, will your team be able to map that to Ariba vendorId on Redwood's side so POs are emitted with the prefix? (if not, we can provide a mapping file)
- MSA edits: Markus, see Sunside's suggested redlines. Can legal propose an internal draft with two options for the residency clause (optional addendum vs inline clause)? Also confirm whether a 5-business-day PO ack is acceptable operationally.

Tentative timeline if we align today:
- Thu 12 Feb: Redwood legal posts a marked-up MSA (fast-track).
- Fri 13 Feb: Ops validates vendor_code field and Ariba activation steps; Laura to request Ariba vendorId and signatory info from Sunside.
- Tue 17 Feb: Final MSA + Order Form to Sunside for signature (DocuSign).

I'll hold a 30-min sync if helpful — available Fri 13th 09:00-11:00 PST.

Thanks,

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Vendor setup + MSA edits for Ariba onboarding

Karthik / Marissa — reviewed Sunside's redline. Summary of our proposed approach and rationale below.

1) EU data residency option
- Option A (preferred for speed): Add an addendum clause that allows customers to select "EU-only" data residency at onboarding; requires a 90-day lead time and may change pricing. Language: "Customer may elect EU-only data residency by executing the Data Residency Addendum; Redwood will not transfer Customer Data outside the elected region for the Services covered by that Addendum."
- Option B (alternative): Insert inline clause with same effect but may require broader internal approval.

2) PO acknowledgement window
- We can accept a 5-business-day acknowledgement requirement on the Order Form, but must qualify service effect: any SLA timers (support, provisioning) will start after acknowledgement. Recommend: include a sentence: "Service provisioning timelines (Section X) commence upon Customer's PO acknowledgement, or 5 business days after issuance if no acknowledgement is received."

3) Vendor code / PO prefix
- Legal doesn't object to adding an optional "vendor_code" metadata field to the Order Form as long as we treat it as a non-substantive mapping field (i.e., does not change acceptance criteria). Ops should ensure the field cannot be used to alter legal terms.

Attachments included: [Redline_MSA_Sunside.docx (docx)] with inline comments. I flagged a minor indemnity formatting item and a data-subprocessor sentence that may need future alignment.

If we go with Option A for data residency and accept the 5-day ack qualification, legal is comfortable fast-tracking a final clean MSA for signature.

-Markus
Markus Klein | Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
